name: io.github.ThoughtProof/thoughtproof-mcp
title: ThoughtProof
description: Local stdio MCP. Hero verify_decision (DQL spend / Sentinel exit). execute true only on ALLOW.

environmentVariables.name: DQL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Required for DQL-backed verify_decision calls. Sentinel and RV paths use their respective keys.

environmentVariables.name: SENTINEL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional; needed when mode=sentinel or auto-route picks Sentinel.

environmentVariables.name: THOUGHTPROOF_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional operator key for verify_claim / verify_trade / Sentinel fallback.
